title: Scenic Full Day Circle Island Tour-Snorkeling/Breakfast/Byodo-in
includes: No more than 13 passengers (non commercial feel)
Umbrellas available to all guests in case of rain
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Pickup and drop off directly from your hotel
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Oahu with a Native Hawaiian guide on a small-group Circle Island adventure limited to just 13 guests.

With the earliest Waikiki pickup available, you’ll beat the crowds, avoid traffic, and spend more time enjoying Oahu’s most beautiful locations. Unlike large commercial bus tours, our experience is designed to be relaxed, personal, and authentic.

✔ Hawaiian breakfast burrito included

✔ Byodo-In Temple admission included

✔ North Shore snorkeling with equipment included

✔ Direct hotel pickup and drop-off

✔ Maximum 13 guests per tour

✔ 10+ stops (over 20 locations)

✔ Return to Waikiki by approximately 2:30 PM

Visit Diamond Head Lookout, Halona Blowhole, Makapuʻu Lookout, Byodo-In Temple, the North Shore, Haleʻiwa, and multiple local food stops! (10+ stops)

Perfect for travelers who want to experience Oahu’s top sights, local culture and food, and famous North Shore without spending the entire day on a crowded bus. (maximum efficiency)
